Letter of May 19, 1972, to the State Clearinghouse from Director of Research,
Archibold Biological Station, Lake Placid, Florida.
Comment: Most of the comments refer to the proposed legislation rather than the draft environmental statement itself. It is observed that none of the four points listed as "Adverse Effects" in the draft statement can really be considered adverse from the standpoint of maintaining a quality environment essential to man's survival.
Response: We acknowledge the point made but the purpose of the EIS is to consider as adverse effects anything that might be considered adverse to anyone impacted by the legislation. This section in the final statement has been rewritten to include several additional points as well as greater explanation of each.
Comment: Prefered is sole administration of the act by the Department of the Interior.
Response: Please refer for comment to our reply to the Florida State Clearinghouse regarding the Interior and Commerce Departments.
